description: This file contains unit tests for the DevOpsRoute class, specifically testing the /devops/piggyback endpoint functionality including normal and erroneous requests.

classes.name: DevOpsRouteTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DevOpsRoute, testing the /devops/piggyback endpoint with valid and invalid JSON payloads.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates DevOpsRoute instance and test route before each test.

methods.name: testPiggyback
methods.description: Tests successful POST request to /devops/piggyback with valid command payload, expects HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: testPiggybackWithJsonException
methods.description: Tests POST request with invalid JSON payload (attribute too long), expects HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: getInsecureDevopsConfig
methods.description: Returns a DevOpsConfig with security disabled, used in test setup.
